name: create_public_preview
title: Create free 2ools preview
description: Turn a complete standalone HTML document already created in this chat into a temporary, read-only 2ools preview. Free and authless; expires after 24 hours. This tool does not generate the page—write the HTML first, then call it.

html.description: Complete standalone HTML document beginning with <!doctype html> or <html>, including its CSS and JavaScript.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-generated retry key. Reuse returns the same preview instead of storing a duplicate.

name: list_build_systems
title: List 2ools build systems
description: List the Curators, Rulebooks, and Skills this paid account may explicitly apply. Use before build_from_conversation when the user names a creative system or asks what is available.

output_target.description: Optional target filter. Omit to list every compatible system available to the account.

name: build_from_conversation
title: Build conversation in 2ools
description: Create a new 2ools project from a structured conversation brief and queue one durable build. Returns project_id and job_id; use get_build to retrieve completion status and the protected preview.

project_name.description: Short name for the new 2ools project.

conversation_summary.description: Factual build brief distilled from the conversation, including the intended artifact and key decisions.

headline.description: Exact hero headline to preserve verbatim in the generated site.

entity.description: Grounded identity facts that must survive the build.

name.description: Exact person, business, product, or project name.

category.description: Entity category, such as musician, restaurant, or SaaS.

source_url.description: Optional source URL supplied by the user.

audience.description: Primary audience and the job they need to complete.

requirements.description: Concrete functionality, content, and section requirements.

pages.description: Pages to generate. Use Home for a one-page site or widget.

visual_direction.description: Desired visual character, composition, color, typography, or references.

content_constraints.description: Claims, wording, exclusions, or fidelity constraints the build must obey.

curator_id.description: Exact Curator ID from list_build_systems. Omit for automatic selection.

rulebook_id.description: Exact compatible Rulebook ID from list_build_systems. Overrides the Curator's default Rulebook.

skill_ids.description: Exact compatible Skill IDs from list_build_systems. When supplied, replaces the Rulebook's default Skill set.

output_target.description: Delivery target: site, browser game, desktop wrapper, embeddable component, floating overlay, or standalone HTML.

model.description: Generation engine. studio is keyless; other models require an available account provider or linked Engine.

max_iterations.description: Hard project cap for later outside-agent child revisions. Defaults to 6 and cannot exceed 12.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-generated unique key. Reusing it returns the original project/job instead of creating a duplicate.

name: refine_project
title: Refine a 2ools project
description: Create one protected child version from a saved base version and concrete review feedback. Preserves the base source as currentCode, consumes one persisted project iteration, and returns an asynchronous job_id.

project_id.description: Project containing the saved base version.

base_version_id.description: Authoritative saved version to use as the parent and current source.

feedback.description: Specific requested changes. Requirements not explicitly changed remain in force.

model.description: Generation engine for this child revision. Studio safely preserves the parent but cannot apply substantive edits; choose an AI model or linked Engine for real revisions.

idempotency_key.description: Unique retry key. Reuse returns the original revision job without consuming another iteration.

name: get_build
title: Get 2ools build
description: Get one build's current status, progress, errors, completed version IDs, and protected preview URLs. Does not return generated source code.

job_id.description: Build job ID returned by build_from_conversation.

name: compare_versions
title: Compare 2ools versions
description: Compare two saved versions in one project without returning source. Reports lineage, review state, page additions/removals, byte sizes, and SHA-256 identity for each page.

name: list_approval_requests
title: List 2ools approval requests
description: List exact saved versions waiting for a separately delegated reviewer. Returns project/version identity and attribution, never generated source.

name: approve_version
title: Approve a 2ools version
description: Use separately delegated review authority to approve one saved version and make it the project's active version. Does not publish, export, or change project permissions.

decision_note.description: Optional review note stored with the delegated decision.

name: reject_version
title: Reject a 2ools version
description: Use separately delegated review authority to reject one saved version. If it is active, restores its saved parent as active; the rejected version remains in immutable history.

decision_note.description: Review feedback explaining what the next child revision should change.

name: cancel_build
title: Cancel 2ools build
description: Cancel a queued or running non-Agent 2ools build. Completed versions are not deleted and terminal builds are left unchanged. Governed Agent execution uses cancel_agent_run.

job_id.description: Build job ID returned by build_from_conversation.

name: list_projects
title: List 2ools projects
description: List recent 2ools projects the authenticated account can access, including owned and shared projects. Returns compact metadata without generated source.

name: get_project
title: Get 2ools project
description: Get a 2ools project's brief, selected pages, active version, and compact version history. Does not return generated source code.

name: get_project_context
title: Get 2ools project operating context
description: Read one source-free operating packet before acting: the active version, exact frozen Curator snapshot, revision-safe Rulebook context, review attention, artifact index, work queue, and current activity cursor. Historical Rulebook text is never guessed after its revision changes.

include_governance_text.description: Include exact Rulebook content and policy when the active version still matches the current Rulebook revision.

name: render_project_preview
title: Show 2ools project preview
description: Render an interactive, read-only card for one saved 2ools version. Use after get_build or get_project when the user wants to see, open, or share the result. Returns protected preview and access-checked workspace links without source code.

name: list_project_agents
title: List project Agents
description: List the authorizing account's built-in Agents assigned to one readable project. This reveals status and summary, not full Limits or run traces.

name: get_agent
title: Inspect a governed 2ools Agent
description: Read one Agent's saved Limits, trigger, immutable revision summaries, and redacted append-only run traces. Raw prompts, tool arguments, credentials, and source bytes are not returned.

name: run_project_agent
title: Run an armed project Agent
description: Queue real execution for a project-linked Agent the person already test-ran and armed. The immutable saved Limits, project access, account fuse, and online Engine requirement are enforced server-side before a job exists.

project_id.description: Project this Agent is assigned to.

task.description: Concrete task for this run. This cannot widen the Agent's saved tools, folders, network, send, change, or spend authority.

model.description: CLI model available through the account's online Engine.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-generated unique key. Reusing it returns the original run instead of starting another.

name: cancel_agent_run
title: Cancel governed Agent run
description: Stop one queued or running Agent execution and close its durable run history. Completed, failed, stalled, and already-canceled runs keep their terminal truth.

project_id.description: Project the Agent run belongs to.

run_id.description: Agent run ID returned by run_project_agent.

job_id.description: Agent job ID returned by run_project_agent.

name: get_project_activity
title: Get 2ools project activity
description: Read the attributable project timeline across human work, external MCP agents, builds, versions, feedback, and workspace pins. Actor kind is explicit; an external agent is never presented as the human account that authorized it.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from a prior response.

name: wait_for_project_activity
title: Wait for new 2ools project activity
description: Wait up to 20 seconds for attributable project events newer than a head_cursor or prior next_cursor. Returns events oldest-first so an outside agent can process them in order. If resync_required is true, paginate get_project_activity instead of advancing the cursor.

after_cursor.description: Opaque head_cursor from get_project_activity or next_cursor from a prior wait.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time to wait before returning timed_out=true.

name: list_project_feedback
title: List project feedback
description: Read page-anchored review feedback for versions in a project, with explicit human or external-agent attribution.

name: add_project_feedback
title: Add project feedback
description: Add an attributable review comment to a saved project version. This does not modify source or approve the version.

reply_to_feedback_id.description: Root feedback ID to reply to. Replies inherit the root pin position and cannot be nested.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-generated retry key. Reusing it returns the original feedback item.

name: resolve_project_feedback
title: Resolve project feedback
description: Owner-only review decision that resolves or reopens one saved feedback item.

name: list_project_pins
title: List workspace pins
description: Read shared workspace notes and http(s) links, with explicit attribution.

name: add_project_pin
title: Add workspace pin
description: Add an attributable note or safe http(s) link to the shared project workspace.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-generated retry key. Reusing it returns the original pin.

name: remove_project_pin
title: Remove workspace pin
description: Remove one shared workspace pin. The operation is idempotent.

name: prepare_version_export
title: Prepare portable version export
description: Create a five-minute download URL for an exact saved version. Source is delivered by the download route, never embedded in MCP model output.

name: get_version_share_link
title: Get exact version share link
description: Read the durable sharing state and current URL for one exact saved version. Disabled shares return no URL.

name: create_version_share_link
title: Create exact version share link
description: Create or recover a durable public or code-protected link for one exact saved version. Reusing the idempotency key returns the original result.

name: revoke_version_share_link
title: Revoke exact version share link
description: Disable every existing public or code-protected URL for one exact saved version. Re-publishing a protected link rotates its code.

name: list_artifacts
title: List project artifacts
description: List durable project artifacts and each latest immutable version without returning stored bytes.

name: get_artifact
title: Get artifact history
description: Read one artifact's immutable version history, provenance, attribution, digests, and review states without returning stored bytes.

name: prepare_artifact_upload
title: Prepare reviewed artifact upload
description: Create a five-minute PUT URL for exact bytes. External-agent output always enters pending review and never replaces the current artifact version before approval.

artifact_id.description: Existing artifact to version. Omit when creating a new artifact.

parent_version_id.description: Required latest version id when updating an existing artifact.

name: prepare_artifact_download
title: Prepare exact artifact download
description: Create a five-minute download URL for one immutable artifact version. Stored bytes never enter MCP model output.

name: list_artifact_approval_requests
title: List artifact review requests
description: List exact artifact versions awaiting or carrying a human review decision. Requires separately delegated artifact review authority.

name: approve_artifact_version
title: Approve exact artifact version
description: Approve one pending immutable artifact version and make it current. Repeating the same decision is idempotent.

name: reject_artifact_version
title: Request artifact changes
description: Reject one pending immutable artifact version with useful feedback. Repeating the same decision is idempotent.

name: list_work_assignments
title: List project work assignments
description: List durable project work contracts, bounded attempts, leases, budgets, and result references.

name: create_work_assignment
title: Create bounded project work
description: Create a durable assignment with acceptance criteria and hard step, time, and spend ceilings.

name: claim_work_assignment
title: Claim bounded project work
description: Atomically claim one open assignment and receive a five-minute renewable lease plus an immutable budget snapshot.

name: heartbeat_work_session
title: Renew a work-session lease
description: Renew the authenticated worker's active lease without widening its immutable step, time, or spend ceilings.

name: submit_work_session
title: Submit work for review
description: End the authenticated worker's lease and submit typed result references for a separate review decision.

name: decide_work_assignment
title: Review submitted project work
description: Complete submitted work or reopen it with useful feedback. Requires separately delegated work-review authority.
